name: Mechanical work by a constant force
subject: mechanics

conditions: Constant nonzero force and nonzero straight displacement, with theta their included angle; zero force or zero displacement gives zero work separately.

evidence: Integrating a constant force along a straight displacement gives the dot product of the force and displacement. The dot product is the product of their magnitudes times the cosine of their included angle.
Reference checked 2026-11-27: https://openstax.org/books/university-physics-volume-1/pages/7-key-equations. Proposed maintainer approval, not independent human certification.
